cases.name: Christine Marie Ezzell
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Christine was a beloved daughter, sister, wife, mother, grandmother, and friend.

Christine graduated from Plainfield High School and continued her education at Quinebaug Valley Community College (QVCC). Throughout her career, she worked for several companies and was eagerly anticipating her retirement this year from The W.I. Clark Company in Plainfield. Her dedication and strong work ethic were evident in all she did. She was known for her genuine love for people, a radiant smile that could brighten any room, and an unwavering devotion to her family.

Christine found joy in life's simple pleasures—seaside dining along the water and visiting the sunflower fields at Buttonwoods were among her favorite pastimes. Her warmth and kindness left an indelible mark on all who knew her."
